title: A pr-route merge waits for the merge gate's allow

story.i_want_to: have a pr-route session stop at a green pull request and have it merged only after loopctl's merge precondition records an allow for its head
story.so_that: Gate A, Gate B over the real diff, custody and the 12-file / 1000-line bound judge every unattended merge, as they already do on the thread route

rationale: HCB PR #3938 (2026-11-07) merged on the session's own word: the runner's pr-mode prompt says 'merge on green' (loopctl-runner dispatch_prompt.ex finish/4), and merge_precondition is exact_role [:orchestrator, :user], so a session cannot call it. Triage ran both gates over the request, but nothing judged the diff that shipped. StageMachine's note above @runner_transitions says who performs the merge 'is undecided in the design'; this story decides it for the pr route: control decides, the runner executes.

acceptance_criteria.description: The pr-mode prompt tells the session to open the pull request, review, fix and wait for green CI, and NOT to merge; a claude-config hook refuses gh pr merge (including --auto) in a loop-mode session (hooks/lib/loop-mode.sh predicate).

For a story at ci on a pr-mode source, a unique-per-story control job runs MergePrecondition over the recorded head; on allow it sends the runner holding the claim a merge instruction naming pr_number and head_sha (new contract message), the runner merges with gh pr merge --squash --match-head-commit and reports ci -> merged with the merge_sha; on refuse the story is escalated as today.
The claim does not lapse while the story waits at ci for the gate: the runner renews it, bounded by the dispatch cap, and a story whose runner is gone is escalated rather than re-queued.
A merge with no allow recorded for its head (a session that merged anyway) is escalated as an ungated merge when it is reported, never silently accepted.

test_cases.name: allow leads to one runner merge and merged
steps: a story at ci with a green head
the runner acks the merge with a merge_sha

test_cases.name: an ungated merge is escalated
steps: report ci -> merged for a head with no merge_gate_allowed_sha
expected_results: escalated, reason names the ungated merge

technical_notes: Contract: a new control -> runner message; runner contract minor bump.
Load .claude/skills/chain-of-custody/SKILL.md before touching the stage machine or the merge gate.
